sv.title: 155 centerpartister i upprop mot ledningens högersväng
sv.summary: 155 centerpartister protesterar i dag i en debattartikel i Expressen mot partiledningens avsikt att rösta ja till en regering med Ulf Kristersson som statsminister.

en.title: 155 Centre Party members protest leadership's shift to the right
en.summary: 155 Centre Party members are protesting today in a debate article in Expressen against the party leadership's intention to vote yes to a government with Ulf Kristersson (M) as prime minister.
